node.title: E1 folded no-vector certificate payload for N'=128
node.statement: Over the named E1 Pocklington field and displayed primitive 128th root, construct a complete machine-checkable folded-kernel certificate proving that no nonzero non-cyclotomic vector w in {-2,-1,0,1,2}^64 satisfies the N'=128 folded kernel equation.
node.attack_surface: actual complete no-vector certificate for the N'=128 folded kernel over the named field/root
node.falsifier: a nonzero non-cyclotomic folded vector in the named N'=128 field/root, or an incomplete certificate transcript
node.notes: FALSE-GREEN CORRECTION: the historical fpylll run reported only rounded summary values. No exact output, basis, shortest-vector proof log, completion flag, deterministic checker, or independent audit is banked; the launcher also catches SVP failure without recording whether exact enumeration succeeded.
